_README: TEMPLATE ONLY — Firebase Cloud Messaging (M7 push) is OFF until you replace this.
1. Create a Firebase project, add an Android app with applicationId 'com.guardianai.guardian_app'.
2. Download the real google-services.json into app/android/app/ (it is gitignored).
3. In app/android/settings.gradle.kts add: id("com.google.gms.google-services") version "4.4.2" apply false
Until then FcmPushService falls back to NoopPushService at runtime and the app still builds.
